scope: No demonstrated Loop-PP advantage over optimized native TP in the tested implementations.
measured_findings: All eight primary arms completed the same 400 actual questions.
Static PP matches all 400 custom Single outputs.
Dynamic PP matches all 400 custom Single outputs and exit traces.
Static task Loop PP is 1.120x faster than Layer PP, but this advantage does not persist across matched replay.
Dynamic task Loop PP is slower than Layer PP on identical output/depth traces.
Native Static controls finish the task cohort sooner than custom PP.
limits: Historical strict TP gate remains FAIL.
Native CDB and custom Single have measured long-generation behavioral drift.
Task clocks include observers and exclude per-cohort graph preparation.
Heavy profile timing is not qualified for headlines.
Optimized PP, optional DP4, and full public suites are NOT_RUN.
GPU_policy: Only physical GPUs4,5,6,7. Authorized burners remain active after the experiment.
